rules.name: conserved
rules.expr: called("fill") and ok and post_sum("credit") + pre("totalPaid") != pre_sum("credit") + post("totalPaid")
rules.why: a fill credits exactly what it charges

rules.name: fill_clears
rules.expr: called("fill") and ok and post("offer", arg(0)) != 0
rules.why: a filled offer is used up

rules.name: fill_clears_b
rules.expr: called("fill") and ok and post("offer", arg(1)) != 0
rules.why: both filled offers are used up

rules.name: place_exact
rules.expr: called("place") and ok and post("offer", sender) != arg(0)

rules.name: place_no_credit
rules.expr: called("place") and ok and post_sum("credit") != pre_sum("credit")

rules.name: place_works

params.condition: arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= 100 and pre("offer", sender) == 0

rules.why: a valid offer can always be placed

rules.name: fill_works
rules.why: a fill whose offers fit is never blocked
